results.locality: At 5:37 am I saw a large platypus travelling up Rocky Creek (I originally thought this was South Maroochy River but it is actually Rocky Creek that leads to Wappa Dam. There was a possible smaller Platypus feeding but cannot be sure. Poor Photo
